reviews.text: Extremely appreciative of Alan and his team. We adopted an adult Pitbull from a rescue. She was great and we consulted with CC on training. About 3 weeks of having her she became aggressive to some regulars at our home including one of our kids. At this point we reached out to the rescue to return her. They said they didn't have space to give them a few days. While all this was happening, we get a call from Alans team who was reaching out to see how it was going.  When i explained what had happen and that we would be returning the dog, they asked if it would be ok to have Alan come by again to chat and evaluate the situation. A few weeks have past since that day and we have decided to keep our dog. Alan gave incredible support, everything he taught me I put into action and I have a different dog today because of him. I don't know what it was that made them call me at that time but I am thankful I didnt have to give up on her!!!THANK YOU!!!!!!!

I saw amazing results by the second lesson, my dog’s behavior improved so quickly! Allan is patient, professional, and makes training clear and enjoyable. The administration support was also excellent, friendly, organized, and always quick to respond. I couldn’t be happier and highly recommend them!
